_why: The Sector Recipe: the promises every Mega-Dungeon sector makes, kept as data so the pacing can be retuned without a new jar. The generator (mega.gen.MegaAssembler) forces these after the first fill and the audit (mega.gen.SectorAudit) enforces them; distances are in 9-block modules measured between box centres. The values below are the defaults compiled into mega.gen.Recipe; the unit test RecipeTest fails if the two drift apart. Keys that start with an underscore are comments.
